newsitem.title: USA: CIBCR Aug US inflation index 104.2 vs 102.5 in Jul.
newsitem.headline: CIBCR Aug US inflation index 104.2 vs 102.5 in Jul.

text.p: The Center for International Business Cycle Research (CIBCR) said its leading inflation index rose to 104.2 in August from 102.5 in July.

Large rises in the percentages of purchasing managers reporting higher prices and slower deliveries made significant contributions to the result, as did a fractional increase in the civilian employment/population ratio, the CIBCR said.

The growth rate of CIBCR's Journal of Commerce industrial materials price index, though remaining negative for the 12th consecutive month, jumped sharply in August, which contributed most to the rise in the inflation index.
The leading inflation index reached a new high for 1996 in August but is still well below most of its values for 1994 and 1995, the CIBCR said.
